channel: Owner message in the engineering chat session (2026-11-13): approved all nine decisions of the Domain Steward design, including decision 9 (delegation charters, pilot on one domain). Recorded by an agent (governance session); this file is the charter text, written by an agent from that decision, not drafted by the owner

kill_switch.global_file: DELEGATION-OFF in the coordination ledger (any content)
kill_switch.rule: Check both at task start and before every approval. When off, every request goes to the owner queue. Narrowing is a new charter version that applies from the next task start; earlier approvals stay and are listed for re-audit.
kill_switch.fail_closed: If the coordination ledger cannot be read, delegation is off. When the switch turns off, pending requests go to the owner and approvals already recorded are listed for re-audit.

why_this_domain: Work here is documents and small tools only: no product behaviour, no trust boundary, reversible by revert, and the gate (spec validation, domain validator, tool tests) checks it mechanically. Domains that touch code in a trust boundary (events-audio, packs, host-core), taste (banner-lab, ui-overlay) or rights (banner-lab, packs) are not suitable pilots.

scope.not_covered: Any path not listed in paths_covered, including every other domain's documents, cards, code and contracts: owner approval.
excluded_always_owner: docs/delivery/AGENT-WORKFLOW.md section 6 (risk tiers), section 8 and section 9, and the rest of that file when a change alters a rule
docs/governance/DECISION-LOG.md and contracts/decisions.json (an agent may draft; only the owner decides)
docs/product/PRD.md and docs/requirements/SRS.md, any requirement, scope, threshold or acceptance change
tools/gate.py and anything else that changes what the gate accepts
any change that relaxes a check, a delegation rule or an owner reservation
this charter and any other charter
scope.tier_precedence: The highest matching tier applies. A change that relaxes a check, a delegation rule or an owner reservation escalates to the owner.

R0.applies_to: documents and mechanical edits inside paths_covered that change no process rule; fixtures; test-only changes
requires: gate pass on the exact commit
scope check: every changed path is inside the brief's SCOPE and inside paths_covered

R1.applies_to: code in tools/validate_domains.py or tools/janitor.py that adds or tightens a check or a report; process documents inside paths_covered that alter a rule other than the owner-reserved ones
requires: gate pass on the exact commit
read-only review by a different model than the author, with every finding accepted, rejected or parked with a reason
the approver is neither the author nor the reviewer

R2.applies_to: nothing inside paths_covered today: everything that would be R2 (trust boundary, contracts, delegation rules, gate criteria) is in excluded_always_owner
R2.note: If the owner later moves a path into R2 scope, a delegate may approve only a recommendation on the feature branch, after the R1 requirements and the lead's full diff read, flagged for owner audit. It never grants commit, push, pull request or merge authority.

design_choices: Only reversible choices inside 'What the builder can decide' in docs/governance/DECISION-LOG.md. Record them as decided_by 'agent delegate, charter CHARTER-governance v1'.

limits.limit_note: per_task_wall_clock_minutes is an agent proposal for the pilot; the owner has not set it

always_the_owner: merge to main, push and pull request
deleting user data, any branch, worktree or folder, or unregistered work
taste: voice, accent, banner look, wording feel
any change to requirements, scope or thresholds
label_rule: An agent result is never written as human or owner approval. Author, reviewer and approver are different sessions; reviewer and author are different models.
approval_queue: One file per request in approvals\ of the coordination ledger; append-only approvals\log.jsonl. No answer in time: escalate to the owner. Nothing is ever approved by timeout.
owner_audit: At each sprint exit: every R2 approval plus a sample of the others (3 items or 10 percent, whichever is larger). A wrong approval narrows this charter.
note: The increments I0 to I3 that created this charter are NOT approved under it: they touch owner-reserved paths and the charter did not exist when they were written. They await the owner's review.
status_note: Written by an agent from decision 9 of the Domain Steward design. Disabled until the owner confirms the text, the scope and the limits (including the wall-clock limit, which the owner has not set). While disabled every approval request goes to the owner.
grants_no_git_authority: A delegated approval never grants commit, push, pull request or merge authority; those stay with the owner (docs/delivery/AGENT-WORKFLOW.md section 6 step 7).
